description: This file is a comprehensive setup and configuration guide for implementing PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) in a Django-based CRM project. It explains the setup process, permissions, environment configuration, migration procedures, verification commands, policies, troubleshooting, and integration specifics related to RLS enforcement within the application.
external_methods: migration scripts to enable RLS policies

methods.name: manage_rls --status
methods.description: Checks and displays the current RLS enforcement status and user privileges.

methods.name: manage_rls --verify-user
methods.description: Verifies that the current database user is not a superuser and properly configured for RLS.

methods.name: manage_rls --test
methods.description: Runs tests to validate RLS enforcement, data isolation, and context setup.

methods.name: set_rls_context
methods.description: Sets the current tenant organization context in the database session, used in background tasks and middleware.

calls: ALTER TABLE "<table>" FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
migrations to add policies and enable RLS on tables
